headline: Stlican Shelf Logs Latest Flip in Quiet Hours
war_summary: The late wires show a marked ebb since the last edition. Fisherman's Row, credited with four changes in two hours around Oceanwatch, and Linn Mercy, with three around Outwich Ranch and Lathair, record none in the last two hours, and Nevish Line falls to a single change from twelve in six hours around Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother and Tomb Father, now held seven Warden to one Colonial. Stlican Shelf supplies the other lone late change, one in two hours amid seventeen in the day around Breaker Town, listed one Warden to eight Colonial and timed at 19:55, the freshest flip on the board. Weathered Expanse, Palantine Berm, Marban Hollow and Godcrofts show no change in two hours despite day totals of twenty-four, thirty, twenty-three and forty-six, the latter still all Colonial. Callahan's Passage again posts the heaviest two-hour casualty bill at 1,870 Colonial and 1,039 Warden without a day flip, while the Deadlands cools sharply to 36 and 8.
